description: This dashboard tracks IP overlap risk and diversity health across the fleet. It helps protect isolation quality and identify concentration problems early.

panels.description: This panel measures duplicate-IP overlap by counting shared IP groups and affected entities. Lower values indicate healthier isolation and reduced operational risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM (
  SELECT last_ip
  FROM proxies
  WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) as dup_ips

panels.title: Duplicate IPs (shared by 2+ phones)

panels.title: Affected Phones (sharing an IP)

panels.title: Top Duplicate IPs by Phone Count

panels.description: This metric shows how many distinct outbound IPs were observed in the selected scope and period. Higher values indicate stronger IP diversity and lower concentration risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(IFNULL(city,'Unknown'), ', ', IFNULL(state,'')) as city_label,
  COUNT(*) as affected_phones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT last_ip) as duplicate_ips
FROM proxies
WHERE ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
AND last_ip IN (
  SELECT last_ip
  FROM proxies
  WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
GROUP BY city, state
ORDER BY affected_phones DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Cities with Most IP-Sharing Phones

panels.description: This metric shows how many distinct outbound IPs were observed in the selected scope and period. Higher values indicate stronger IP diversity and lower concentration risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_unknown_location = 1 THEN 'No Location (N/A)'
    WHEN city_label IS NULL AND state_label IS NULL THEN 'Unknown, '
    ELSE CONCAT(IFNULL(city_label, 'Unknown'), ', ', IFNULL(state_label, ''))
  END as location_label,
  avg_lat,
  avg_lon,
  affected_phones,
  duplicate_ips
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN p.latitude IS NULL
        OR p.longitude IS NULL
        OR p.city IS NULL
        OR p.city = ''
        OR LOWER(p.city) = 'n/a'
        OR p.state IS NULL
        OR p.state = ''
        OR LOWER(p.state) = 'n/a'
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as is_unknown_location,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN p.latitude IS NULL
          OR p.longitude IS NULL
          OR p.city IS NULL
          OR p.city = ''
          OR LOWER(p.city) = 'n/a'
          OR p.state IS NULL
          OR p.state = ''
          OR LOWER(p.state) = 'n/a'
        THEN 32.5
        ELSE p.latitude
      END
    ) as avg_lat,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN p.latitude IS NULL
          OR p.longitude IS NULL
          OR p.city IS NULL
          OR p.city = ''
          OR LOWER(p.city) = 'n/a'
          OR p.state IS NULL
          OR p.state = ''
          OR LOWER(p.state) = 'n/a'
        THEN -119.5
        ELSE p.longitude
      END
    ) as avg_lon,
    COUNT(*)                  as affected_phones,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.last_ip) as duplicate_ips,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(p.city  ORDER BY p.city  SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) as city_label,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(p.state ORDER BY p.state SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) as state_label
  FROM proxies p
  WHERE ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
    AND p.last_ip IN (
      SELECT last_ip
      FROM proxies
      WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
      AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
      GROUP BY last_ip
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN p.latitude IS NULL
        OR p.longitude IS NULL
        OR p.city IS NULL
        OR p.city = ''
        OR LOWER(p.city) = 'n/a'
        OR p.state IS NULL
        OR p.state = ''
        OR LOWER(p.state) = 'n/a'
      THEN 'unknown'
      ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(p.latitude, 1), ':', ROUND(p.longitude, 1))
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN p.latitude IS NULL
        OR p.longitude IS NULL
        OR p.city IS NULL
        OR p.city = ''
        OR LOWER(p.city) = 'n/a'
        OR p.state IS NULL
        OR p.state = ''
        OR LOWER(p.state) = 'n/a'
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
) t
ORDER BY affected_phones DESC

panels.title: Geographic Distribution of Duplicate IP Phones

panels.description: This panel measures duplicate-IP overlap by counting shared IP groups and affected entities. Lower values indicate healthier isolation and reduced operational risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  last_ip,
  COUNT(*) as phone_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN proxy_status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN proxy_status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactive_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY name SEPARATOR ', ') as phones,
  GROUP_CONCAT(device_id ORDER BY name SEPARATOR ', ') as device_ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IFNULL(city,'?') ORDER BY city SEPARATOR ', ') as cities,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IFNULL(country,'?') ORDER BY country SEPARATOR ', ') as countries
FROM proxies
WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
GROUP BY last_ip
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY phone_count DESC, last_ip

panels.title: Duplicate IPs — Summary (one row per shared IP)

panels.description: This metric shows how many distinct outbound IPs were observed in the selected scope and period. Higher values indicate stronger IP diversity and lower concentration risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  server,
  COUNT(DISTINCT last_ip) as duplicate_ips,
  COUNT(*) as affected_phones
FROM (
  SELECT
    last_ip,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END as server
  FROM proxies
  WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  AND last_ip IN (
    SELECT last_ip
    FROM proxies
    WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
    GROUP BY last_ip
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )
) AS t
GROUP BY server
ORDER BY duplicate_ips DESC, affected_phones DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Duplicate IPs Per Server

panels.description: Splits each server's current duplicate-IP exposure into within-server collisions (only this server's phones are on the IP) and cross-server collisions (this server plus at least one other). Reflects the most recent duplicate-IP capture (taken roughly every 5 minutes) and is scoped by ${proxy_status}.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers
  WHERE proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
),
ip_server_counts AS (
  SELECT s.last_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(s.server_label)) AS distinct_servers_on_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at = s.captured_at
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
  GROUP BY s.last_ip
)
SELECT
  TRIM(s.server_label) AS server,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.distinct_servers_on_ip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_server_dup_ips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.distinct_servers_on_ip > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cross_server_dup_ips
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at = s.captured_at
JOIN ip_server_counts c ON c.last_ip = s.last_ip
WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
GROUP BY TRIM(s.server_label)
ORDER BY (within_server_dup_ips + cross_server_dup_ips) DESC, server

panels.title: Within vs Cross-Server Duplicate IPs Per Server

panels.description: This metric shows how many distinct outbound IPs were observed in the selected scope and period. Higher values indicate stronger IP diversity and lower concentration risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  server_pair,
  COUNT(DISTINCT last_ip) as shared_ips
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.last_ip,
    CONCAT(
      LEAST(
        CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(a.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(a.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END,
        CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(b.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(b.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(b.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(b.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END
      ),
      ' vs ',
      GREATEST(
        CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(a.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(a.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END,
        CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(b.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(b.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(b.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(b.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END
      )
    ) as server_pair
  FROM proxies a
  JOIN proxies b ON a.last_ip = b.last_ip AND a.device_id < b.device_id
  WHERE a.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND a.last_ip != ''
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR a.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR b.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
) as pairs
GROUP BY server_pair
ORDER BY shared_ips DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top Server Pairs Sharing IPs

panels.description: This metric shows how many distinct outbound IPs were observed in the selected scope and period. Higher values indicate stronger IP diversity and lower concentration risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.state_label AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS duplicate_devices,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.last_ip) AS duplicate_ips
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.last_ip,
    CASE
      WHEN p.state IS NULL OR TRIM(p.state) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(p.state)) = 'n/a'
      THEN 'unknown_state'
      ELSE LOWER(TRIM(p.state))
    END AS state_key,
    CASE
      WHEN p.state IS NULL OR TRIM(p.state) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(p.state)) = 'n/a'
      THEN 'Unknown State'
      ELSE TRIM(p.state)
    END AS state_label
  FROM proxies p
  JOIN (
    SELECT last_ip
    FROM proxies
    WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
      AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
    GROUP BY last_ip
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  ) dup ON p.last_ip = dup.last_ip
  WHERE ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
) s
GROUP BY s.state_key, s.state_label
ORDER BY duplicate_devices DESC, duplicate_ips DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Duplicate IP Impact by State

panels.description: This panel measures duplicate-IP overlap by counting shared IP groups and affected entities. Lower values indicate healthier isolation and reduced operational risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.last_ip,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.location ORDER BY x.location SEPARATOR ' | ') AS location,
  MAX(dup.all_servers_on_ip) AS all_servers_on_ip,
  MAX(dup.phones_on_same_ip) AS phones_on_same_ip,
  MAX(dup.sibling_phones) AS sibling_phones,
  GROUP_CONCAT(x.name ORDER BY x.name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS phone_names,
  GROUP_CONCAT(x.device_id ORDER BY x.name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS device_ids
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.name,
    p.device_id,
    p.last_ip,
    p.proxy_status,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(TRIM(p.city), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.state), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.country), '')) AS location
  FROM proxies p
  WHERE p.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.last_ip != ''
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
) x
JOIN (
  SELECT
    last_ip,
    COUNT(*) AS phones_on_same_ip,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END) = 'Unknown' THEN 999999 ELSE CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR((CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END), '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED) END
      SEPARATOR ', '
    ) AS all_servers_on_ip,
    GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS sibling_phones
  FROM proxies
  WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) dup ON x.last_ip = dup.last_ip
GROUP BY x.last_ip
ORDER BY MAX(dup.phones_on_same_ip) DESC, x.last_ip

panels.title: Cross-Server Duplicate IP — Per-Phone Detail

panels.description: This panel measures duplicate-IP overlap by counting shared IP groups and affected entities. Lower values indicate healthier isolation and reduced operational risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  x.city_label AS city,
  x.last_ip,
  COUNT(*) AS duplicate_devices,
  GROUP_CONCAT(x.name ORDER BY x.name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS names,
  GROUP_CONCAT(x.device_id ORDER BY x.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS device_ids
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.last_ip,
    p.device_id,
    p.name,
    CASE
      WHEN p.city IS NULL OR TRIM(p.city) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(p.city)) = 'n/a'
      THEN 'Unknown City'
      ELSE TRIM(p.city)
    END AS city_label,
    CASE
      WHEN p.city IS NULL OR TRIM(p.city) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(p.city)) = 'n/a'
      THEN 'unknown_city'
      ELSE LOWER(TRIM(p.city))
    END AS city_key
  FROM proxies p
  WHERE p.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.last_ip != ''
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
) x
GROUP BY x.city_key, x.city_label, x.last_ip
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY duplicate_devices DESC, x.city_label ASC, x.last_ip ASC
LIMIT 200
